description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens (measured in thousands) across various categories in the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis represents different categories, which include Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis indicates the number of tokens, with a scale ranging from 0 to 10,000 tokens. The News category has the highest number of tokens, with a value of 10,584, followed by the Administrative category with 6,472 tokens. The Religion category has 6,052 tokens, while the Non-fiction category has 1,889 tokens. The Science category has 1,626 tokens, and the Blogs category has the least number of tokens, with a value of 32. The Fiction and Law categories have 387 and 354 tokens, respectively. The bars are colored in sky blue, and the values are annotated above each bar in dark blue text. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding of bars.
